scope: Apply the verified October 14 critique fixes in place on Pages 24-29, including the Vidra Fresh token and text-style migration for non-archive sections.
approach: Fixes were made in the original components so every consumer inherits them; copying the Page 30 screens over the originals would have changed node IDs and broken prototype links and design-doc references.
Component layers were rebound before instance layers, so instances keep inheriting instead of collecting overrides.
Every script was guarded to write only on its own page and was idempotent; failed scripts were rolled back by Figma and rerun.

The plugin API cannot save a named version ('saveVersionHistoryAsync is not a supported API'); Figma's automatic version history is the restore path, and every structural change below records its previous value.
